title: Worker Lease Safety
content: Lease fencing prevents stale workers from committing workflow state after ownership changes. A fencing token must be checked at the durable commit boundary.

title: Private Memory Lifecycle
content: Owner-scoped private memory supports JSON export, explicit deletion, expiry filtering, and removal from the FTS5 index.

title: Local Model Provider
content: The Ollama adapter is opt-in and accepts loopback HTTP only. Failed local inference never silently falls back to a cloud provider.

title: Untrusted Retrieval Instructions
content: Retrieved documents are untrusted evidence. Instructions embedded in knowledge passages must never grant tool permissions, override policy, or authorize external actions.

title: Stale Source Handling
content: Knowledge sources can be marked stale, unknown, or owner reviewed current. These labels are manually declared and are not independent automatic freshness verification.

title: External Workflow Recovery
content: When a remote side effect may have succeeded but its result was not persisted, recovery records unknown outcome and must not automatically replay the external operation.

title: Bounded Agent Execution
content: The model-driven agent enforces maximum turns, tool-call limits, total input budgets, schema validation, and independent policy checks for every proposed tool call.
